summary: Multiple missile launches from Iranian sites including Khomeini Shahr and Qorveh indicate heightened military activity. Drone strikes in southern Lebanon and rocket alerts on the Israeli border signal ongoing cross-border tension. Israeli political deadlock persists as Eisenkot downplays immediate Iranian threat while Chief of Staff calls for larger forces.

sections.executive_summary: Multiple missile launches from Iranian sites including Khomeini Shahr and Qorveh indicate heightened military activity. Drone strikes in southern Lebanon and rocket alerts on the Israeli border signal ongoing cross-border tension. Israeli political deadlock persists as Eisenkot downplays immediate Iranian threat while Chief of Staff calls for larger forces.

points: At 1109Z (14:39 Tehran time), a missile was launched from Khomeini Shahr in Isfahan Province, marking the first of multiple launches from the site. (Source: @shin_persian/12775)
A second missile launch from Khomeini Shahr, Isfahan occurred at 15:02 local time (1132Z), indicating repeated activity from the same location. (Source: @shin_persian/12780)
Two missiles were launched from Qorveh in Kurdistan Province at 17:11 local time (1341Z), expanding the geographic scope of launches. (Source: @shin_persian/12784)
A helicopter patrol was conducted over Khorramabad, Lorestan Province at 14:20 local time (1050Z), suggesting aerial surveillance or readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/12773)
Military movement was detected at the gate of Ashura Garrison in Iran at 16:47 local time (1317Z), pointing to possible force repositioning. (Source: @shin_persian/12781)
Following a security briefing from Netanyahu, Eisenkot stated he does not see a direct and immediate Iranian threat requiring military action before government formation. (Source: @amitsegal/67460)

The Chief of Staff, during a Southern Command exercise, warned that the IDF requires increased force sizes to meet significantly expanded operational challenges across all arenas. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)
Bennett condemned Jewish terror in the West Bank, asserting that administrative detentions were cancelled for primary votes, endangering soldiers and settlers. (Source: @amitsegal/67456)
Yair Golan declared the Democrats will not join a unity government with Netanyahu, demanding a clear alternative framework by week's end. (Source: @yediotnews25/138376)
Yisrael Beiteinu decided to vote against Haredi-backed laws freezing deserter arrests, highlighting coalition fractures. (Source: @amitsegal/67463)

Bennett warned that Jewish terror in the West Bank inflicts enormous damage on Israel and threatens the settlement enterprise, blaming cancelled administrative detentions on political calculations. (Source: @amitsegal/67456)
No other explicit operational updates from Gaza or West Bank in the provided messages.
A drone exploded on the roof of a building in the town of Hadatha, causing unspecified damage. (Source: @redlinkleb/54630)
A booby-trapped drone detonated in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Hay al-Anisi, indicating continued use of explosive UAVs. (Source: @redlinkleb/54625)
A Hermes 450 drone (registration 750) circled central Beirut at 7,000 feet from 11:10, repositioning at 13:10, with no flights recorded on November 22. (Source: @redlinkleb/54606)
Observers tracked a Hermes 450 armed with four missiles flying at low altitude over Beirut's southern suburbs, suggesting armed reconnaissance or strike posture. (Source: @redlinkleb/54652)
Rocket sirens activated in the Lebanese border communities of Even Menahem and Shtula; the IDF is investigating the cause. (Source: @manniefabian/59571)

key_developments: Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles from Khomeini Shahr (Isfahan) and Qorveh (Kurdistan) between 1109Z and 1341Z, alongside helicopter patrols in Lorestan and military movement at Ashura Garrison, indicating heightened readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/12775, @shin_persian/12780, @shin_persian/12784, @shin_persian/12773, @shin_persian/12781)

Lebanese territory experienced three drone incidents: an explosion in Hadatha, a booby-trapped drone in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and an armed Hermes 450 overflying Beirut with four missiles, signaling sustained Israeli UAV operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/54630, @redlinkleb/54625, @redlinkleb/54606, @redlinkleb/54652)
Rocket alert sirens sounded in Even Menahem and Shtula on the Israeli-Lebanese border; the IDF has not identified the launch source. (Source: @manniefabian/59571, @tzevaadom_en/68586)

Israeli Chief of Staff declared the IDF requires larger force structures to address expanded operational challenges across all fronts, warning that significant escalation would necessitate new planning. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)
Opposition leader Eisenkot assessed no immediate Iranian threat warranting pre-government military action, contrasting with military's call for increased resources. (Source: @amitsegal/67460)

Political deadlock deepens as Yisrael Beiteinu opposes Haredi draft laws, Yair Golan rejects unity with Netanyahu, and Ahmed Tibi offers facilitation for a change bloc government. (Source: @amitsegal/67463, @yediotnews25/138376, @yediotnews25/138378)
Bennett accused the outgoing government of cancelling administrative detentions of Jewish extremists for primary votes, endangering West Bank stability and IDF focus. (Source: @amitsegal/67456)
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous missile launches from multiple Iranian sites suggest a coordinated exercise or demonstration of capability rather than an immediate attack posture. Armed Hermes 450 operations over Beirut with live munitions indicate Israel maintains persistent armed surveillance and strike readiness over Lebanese territory. The rocket alerts on the northern border without claimed responsibility raise the risk of miscalculation. Israeli military leadership's call for force expansion contrasts with political assessments downplaying the Iranian threat, creating a potential planning gap. West Bank instability driven by Jewish extremist violence further diverts IDF resources from other fronts.
sections.regional_response: Iran's missile activity from Isfahan and Kurdistan provinces may signal deterrence messaging amid regional tensions. Lebanon's Hezbollah has not commented on the drone strikes in Hadatha and Nabatieh, but the armed Hermes 450 overflight represents a direct Israeli challenge to Lebanese airspace. The Israeli political impasse delays coherent security policy, with Eisenkot's stance potentially constraining military options. Gulf states remain unmentioned in current reporting, though Iranian missile demonstrations could heighten their security concerns. The absence of Syrian or Iraqi militia activity in feeds suggests a current focus on the Israeli-Lebanese-Iranian triangle.
